content: Bitwarden core free tier: unlimited logins/notes/cards/identities, cross-device sync, password generator, import from other managers, autofill, biometric unlock, password history. Premium adds: TOTP authenticator, vault health alerts/breach monitoring, phishing blocker, file attachments, emergency access, security reports. Security: AES-256 encryption, passkey support, 2FA, password auditing. Open source (auditable).
